title: Lemon-Herb Grilled {p} with {v}
steps: Toss the {p} with oil, a squeeze of lemon, salt and the {spice}. Leave to marinate 20 minutes.
Start the sides while the {p} marinates. {starch_how} {veg_how}
Grill or pan-sear the {p} over medium-high heat, 6 to 8 minutes per side, until {doneness}.
Serve the {p} with the {v} and {s}, with the {sauce} drizzled over.
tip: Marinating in lemon and herbs instead of cream or butter keeps lean chicken flavorful and light.
